title: fix(app-shell): rename the deployment notice state module so it no longer differs from the component only in case
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9R6fQuMSzSrRW2oowG4K2kQ)_

Part of #34705

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — an internal module rename; no skill page names either file.

> The first of two PRs for #34705. This one is the fix (the rename), so macOS builds work as soon as it lands. The second adds the repository-wide gate (`check:module-name-case`, one step in `lint.yml`, which is Tier H under the workflows split); it is held until this one merges, because the gate is red on `main` until then. The second PR closes the card.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice/deploymentNotice.ts` 改名为 `deploymentNoticeState.ts`，它的两个导入方（`DeploymentNotice.tsx` 和它的测试）跟着改。一处注释里的文件名同步。
- **为什么改**：同一目录里 `DeploymentNotice.tsx`（组件）和 `deploymentNotice.ts`（状态模块）只差大小写。在 macOS 默认的大小写不敏感文件系统上，`'../deployment-notice/DeploymentNotice.js'` 解析到了状态模块，`tsc` 构建 app-shell 失败（`TS2724`、`TS1261`）。
- **风险与回滚**：纯改名，包的导出不变，行为不变。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- **先看**：`DeploymentNotice.tsx:49` 的导入。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice`，预期全绿；`git ls-files ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice` 里不再有两个只差大小写的名字。
- **需要你做的**：无；本 PR 走普通队列。

## What changes

- `deploymentNotice.ts` → `deploymentNoticeState.ts` (git rename, content unchanged).
- `DeploymentNotice.tsx:49` and `__tests__/DeploymentNotice.test.tsx:31` import the new name; the docblock at `DeploymentNotice.tsx:27` names it.
- `.changeset/34705-deployment-notice-state-module-name.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

The component's importers (`console/home/HomePage.tsx:39`, `views/DashboardView.tsx:40`, the HomePage tests' `vi.mock('../../deployment-notice/DeploymentNotice')`) already spell the component and are untouched: on a case-insensitive file system they now reach the only file of that name.

## Premise

On `origin/main` f6f5b50a05 the folder holds `DeploymentNotice.tsx` and `deploymentNotice.ts`. The pair differs in extension too, so a lower-cased `git ls-files` dedupe finds nothing; compared by the name an import spells (extension removed), they collide. A scan of every tracked path on `main` by that rule finds exactly this pair, and none on this branch (25,990 paths). Reproduced from the tree, not on a macOS file system (the container's is case-sensitive).

## Verification

See the final-head comment for the head this covers.
